newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Relief group offers aid to Kurd refugees in Iran.
newsitem.headline: Relief group offers aid to Kurd refugees in Iran.

text.p: The medical relief group Medecins Sans Frontieres (MSF) said on Saturday it had launched an emergency operation to help the tens of thousands of Kurdish refugees who have fled from Iraq into Iran.
"Except for some tents, nothing is available," MSF worker Sotiris Papaspyropoulos said in a statement. "No shelter, no latrines, no medical materials. The situation is abominable."
MSF said it had chartered a plane to fly from Ostend, Belgium with 30 tonnes of medical, sanitary and other materials to Iran. It said it would also expand its team in Iran from five to 13.
Iran said on Wednesday it was sheltering 39,000 Kurdish refugees who had fled the takeover of northern Iraq by a Baghdad-backed Kurdish faction.
MSF said about 20,000 refugees were concentrated near the border town of Baneh.
